predictions.text: I predict that the verdict and sentence will be announced for a prominent individual, finding them guilty and sentencing them to life in prison without the possibility of parole.
I predict that the Saudi Arabia-led coalition will launch another airstrike in Yemen, targeting a residential area in Taiz, resulting in at least 10 civilian casualties.
I predict that the protests against the rising cost of living and military conscription will spread to at least two more cities in Germany.
I predict that a local government official from Uttarakhand will be called to testify first at the inquest regarding the cause of the crash.

I predict that a prominent legal body will rule on the constitutionality of a leader's suspension and the legality of resignations, but will not provide a final decision by the end of Sunday, 8 November 2026, leaving the situation unresolved.
